title: The Karl Eberhards Corpus of spontaneously spoken southern German in dialogues
manual_evidence: Praat TextGrids manually corrected at word level; segment boundaries are forced-aligned and therefore explicitly ineligible unless separately human-verified
available_primary_data: audio WAV; Praat TextGrids; EMA for subset; participant questionnaire; processing R scripts; reduced-form lexicon
license: BAS ACA: free for scientific users; otherwise licence required
notes: Current corpus description reports 40 dialogues / 79 speakers and EMA for 20 speakers. Admit only the manually corrected word-boundary layer and primary EMA/audio metadata; do not promote automatically aligned segment boundaries. Earlier 2016 paper described 35 dialogues and 13 EMA speakers, so counts are versioned rather than conflated.
